name: FilterGallery
description: Worker-rendered thumbnails; the source reader is debounced and cancelled on replacement.
signature: ({ items, source, scale, detailScale, documentWidth, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, disabled, className, "aria-label": name }: FilterGalleryProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible gallery name. Defaults to the effects message pack.

props.name: detailScale
props.description:
The least thumbnail pixels per document pixel that effects render at. A thumbnail shows the
whole picture, so a faithful miniature would shrink a 2 px pencil line or a grain to nothing;
this keeps each effect's character visible. Default 0.5, about how the picture reads at Fit.
Pass 0 for a faithful miniature.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable selections while the source loads.

props.name: documentWidth
props.description: Original document width, when the async reader chooses its own pyramid level.

props.name: items
props.description: Candidates; names can come from any host message catalogue.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when a candidate is chosen. Selection alone never commits an edit.

props.name: scale
props.description: Source pixels per document pixel, when `documentWidth` is not given. Default 1.

props.name: source
props.description: Linear premultiplied thumbnail pixels, or an async reader such as session.readPreview.
